projects.title: Feedback Limit
projects.description: This is a mostly experimental artwork. I´ve discover this while travelling in the bus using the shader editor in android(wich i recommend cause is really really cool to make things fast). Those longs hours in the bus teach me weird techniques. This is based on a technique that accumulates feedback and once that passes certain limit(it depends on the edition) it decreases on another generative value(it deppens on the edition as well). Is rendered on a fragment shader in my p5.js system.
